lines.text: When the Philistines seized David in Gath, he asked God for mercy because men hounded him all day.
When David is afraid, he puts his trust in God, whose word he praises, and he will not be afraid.
David's enemies twist his words all day, and they lurk and watch his steps, waiting to take his life.
David asks God to cast down the nations and put his songs in God's bottle, and his enemies will retreat.
David will give thank offerings to God, who delivered his soul from shame so he may walk before God.
